"""Larger randomized end-to-end: many prefixes, many queries, all lookup paths."""
import random, sys, json, time
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp/dev')
from harness import *
import imgtool
from collections import Counter

rng = random.Random(int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 2024)
N = int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 2000
NQ = int(sys.argv[3]) if len(sys.argv) > 3 else 3000

# mixed structure: clustered prefixes (deep trees) + spread ones
fib = []
seen = set()
clusters = [rng.getrandbits(128) & ~((1 << (128 - rng.choice([16, 32, 48, 64, 80]))) - 1) for _ in range(40)]
while len(fib) < N:
    if rng.random() < 0.7:
        base = rng.choice(clusters)
        L = rng.randint(0, 128)
        a = ref.mask(base | rng.getrandbits(128), L)
    else:
        L = rng.randint(0, 128)
        a = ref.mask(rng.getrandbits(128), L)
    if (a, L) in seen: continue
    seen.add((a, L))
    fib.append((a, L, rng.randint(0, 4194302)))
q = []
for _ in range(NQ):
    r = rng.random()
    if r < 0.45: q.append(rng.choice(fib)[0] | rng.getrandbits(128))
    elif r < 0.6: q.append(rng.choice(fib)[0])
    else: q.append(rng.getrandbits(128))
q = [ref.mask(x, 128) for x in q]
t0 = time.time()
ok, img = check_fib('big%d-seed%s' % (N, sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 0), fib, q[:1000], verbose=True)
print('elapsed %.1fs' % (time.time() - t0))
nodes = imgtool.find_nodes(img)
print('types', Counter(n['type'] for n in nodes), 'cells', sum(img['cells']),
      'rows', sum(len(b) for b in img['banks']), 'dict', len(img['bitmaps']), 'ni', len(img['nexthops']))
PYEOF
